debug.changelog:
fix: resolve login CAPTCHA validation issues and 12087 session errors

* fix: prevent duplicate CAPTCHA token consumption in `AuthRepository` by ensuring the token is only sent once across login phases
* fix: manually re-inject critical headers (`x-pm-uid`, `x-pm-appversion`, `x-pm-apiversion`) in `CaptchaScreen` to prevent WebView from stripping them during proxying
* fix: force a fresh session restart when encountering error 12087 (CAPTCHA session expired) instead of retrying an invalidated session
* refactor: load direct Proton URLs in `CaptchaScreen` to ensure `shouldInterceptRequest` correctly identifies and proxies traffic
* refactor: simplify `LoginViewModel` and `AuthRepository` by removing redundant comments and internal metrics logging
* feat: add a failsafe to require a valid session ID before triggering the CAPTCHA flow to ensure proper token binding
